faq_heading: Homes near Port Guichon Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Port Guichon Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Port Guichon Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Port Guichon Elementary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Port Guichon Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 28 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,100,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Port Guichon Elementary?
faq.a: For the 28 homes that sold within 1 km of Port Guichon Elementary, the median time on the market was 21 days and the median sale was 97.0% of list; 4% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Port Guichon Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Ladner Elementary (0.9 km east), Delta Secondary (1.2 km east) and Delta Christian School (1.7 km north-east).

Port Guichon Elementary is an elementary school in Delta (Delta School District), at 4381 46a St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Port Guichon Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Port Guichon Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Port Guichon Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Port Guichon Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 28 homes sold within 1 km of Port Guichon Elementary: 17 houses, 2 townhomes and 4 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,100,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Port Guichon Elementary

6 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Port Guichon Elementary in a straight line (4 elementary, 2 secondary; 2 independent). The closest is Ladner Elementary, 0.9 km away, and the farthest on this list is Delta Access, 2.6 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Delta Secondary (1.2 km); the nearest independent school is Delta Christian School (1.7 km). Other elementary schools close by: Ladner Elementary (0.9 km east), Delta Christian School (1.7 km north-east), Sacred Heart (1.8 km south-east), Hawthorne Elementary (2.4 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Ladner Elementary, 0.9 km east of Port Guichon Elementary.
